第九章 一个尸兵
郭飞将剑影热流和外界吐纳得来的的气流比较一下，两者本是同源气体，但剑影入体化作的热流，其能量更为精纯，让郭飞对兵符信心大增。
“难道这就是他们口中的五行真气！”郭飞猜测道。
“轰！”正当郭飞感到已经力不从心，准备减缓攻击的时候，体内一荡，似乎天地间的一股浩大的气流陡然贯入了身体内，好似逆转了规则，强行注入体内，剑影真气瞬间补满，似乎比刚才更加的厚实和精纯一丝。
“剑兵二级，增加了一点攻击力，升级了。”郭飞神识探入了兵符空间中，瞬间得到了信息。这让郭飞欣喜异常，果然可以升级，升级竟然可以让气力补满。
鬼族骷髅兵在和人族步兵交战中节节败退了。相对于人族来说，鬼族兵器落后，兵力也少于人族，交战持续三个时辰，人族步兵将鬼族赶到了落日沙漠鬼族释放的雾海边缘。
“嗷嗷！”一声刺耳的鬼叫，骷髅兵如潮水般的躲进了迷雾中。
“不对劲！兄弟们，后退。”在其余士兵欢呼追击的同时，金大通眉头紧皱，赶紧提醒道。
队形立即化作了“锥形”，郭飞从领头变成末尾，十人急匆匆的后撤。
“轰轰轰！”一阵震天的响声传来，迷雾中冲出了一群群的骨马鬼骑，朝人族步兵杀来。
这些鬼骑全身套着黑亮的铠甲，迷雾遮住了脸庞，手中一杆雪亮的骨枪，一排排的冲击，一个回合就将人族的士兵杀死了一片。
郭飞等人的队伍在战场的最外围，撤退的速度不慢，但后面鬼骑冲来的速速更快。
“这么多骷髅骑士！”金大通惊恐的大叫一声，带着九人斜着朝战场边缘的一个大石头后面躲去。
骑兵明显的克制步兵，一丈多长的骑士枪瞬间将一个个的步兵挑起，砸在后面的步兵身体上，掀起了一片血雨。即使受伤没死，也被瞬间疾驰而过的粗大的骨马蹄子践踏成肉泥。
“铛铛铛！”这个时候，人族的鸣金收兵锣才响起。
“奶奶个熊，谁当的指挥官，不是让弟兄们送死么！”金大通领着十人躲进了战场边缘边一个石头丛后面的缝隙中，躲避着骷髅骑士的袭击。
十人趴在雪堆中，将石头缝隙中的雪往身体上盖了盖，遮蔽了起来。郭飞趴在最外面，从缝隙中观察整个战场。
幸而找到了这个隐身的地方，后退的步兵根本跑不过骷髅骑兵，一排排的倒下，人族的骑兵这时才蜂拥的从黑壁的骑兵通道中冲出来。
“老大，你说人族会败么？”老八也是第一次参加这样的大战，有点担心道。
“不知道，等着看吧，我们都是炮灰，真正决定胜负的不是我们。那些高手都蓄势待发，准备最后决战，他们才是决定最后胜负的关键，我们不过是消耗力量罢了。”金大通闭着眼睛恢复体力，淡淡道。

“炮灰！”老九一怔，眼神中露出了一丝悲哀。
“兄弟，蚂蚁多了也能啃死大象，这样的战斗，高手只能最后出场，他们要是也参加混战，指不定会被围攻而死，每个高手都是王国的宝贝，不会白白在这里送死的，参加这样的混战，大部分是我们这样的低级武者。只有少部分营长才是气修士。”老二淡淡一笑解释道。
“哧哧哧！”老二刚说完，一个人影从战场中央急速的朝这边的大石头奔来。郭飞一看顿时一怔，此人正是一名营长，在黑壁列阵的时候，他的营在郭飞等人的右侧，郭飞见过此人，好像姓杨。
杨营长明显的受了伤，胳膊和大腿各种了一枪，后面有十几个骑士紧紧追杀。其中一个骑士，手中一杆黑色的长枪，骑的马匹并不是骨马，而是一只真正的马匹，不过是死去的马匹。其皮肤像缩水一样紧紧的贴在骨骼上，眼中闪着暗红的光芒，在没入小腿深的积雪中快如闪电的飞驰。
“不好，鬼马黑骑。这可是中级鬼卫呀！比上次偷袭我们军营的还厉害。”老二紧张的低喝一身，连闭目休息的金大通也一愣怔，睁开眼赶紧偷瞄。
“奶奶个熊，这估计是鬼族骑兵的一个小头领。这次鬼族准备玩大的，我在这里两年，从来没有听过见过这样的高等级鬼兵。兄弟们，准备逃！”金大通挥挥手，示意众人赶紧往大石头后面闪。准备在石头遮蔽下从侧面逃走。
“哧！”鬼马黑骑手中长枪一挑，闪出了一道灰色的气旋，直接撞在杨营长的后背上，杨营长被灰色气旋撞飞了出去，铠甲崩裂，露出了一个巨大的伤口，一头扎进雪窝中，口中喷出了两口鲜血。鬼马黑骑一窜，一枪补在其后背上，转身离去。
“没救了。死气入体，回天乏术。”金大通叹息一声，露出了一丝无奈。但似乎看惯了这样的事情，平静的叹息而已。
杨营长艰难的抬起头，眼中渐渐失去光彩，一团灰气弥漫全身。
“纵然是这样的强者，在这样的战场也死的不明不白。如同蝼蚁之命，我会不会也如此！”杨营长曾经在他心目中是威风凛凛的高手，郭飞眼中露出了一丝惋惜，心中暗自一声叹息。
不过，转眼间，不屈的信念在郭飞心中萌发。纵然是蝼蚁，也要抱着化蝶高飞希望，高歌前行，不能失去信心。
此时，郭飞离杨营长只有十几米远，透着大石头的缝隙观察。在他眼睛快要闭上的瞬间，郭飞发现自己的兵符中，尸兵堂中光芒一闪，好似有了反应。
尸兵堂，郭飞的灵识也进入查看过，在尸兵堂的空间中排列着二百个黑黝黝的巨大棺材，每个棺材都是实质的，不知道是什么材料制作的。在棺材中有一团惨白色的长方型光影，如同幽灵一样。
此时，在尸兵堂的一个棺材中，那惨白色的光影有了一丝灰气，好似要飞出来一样。
“难道可以化为尸兵，试一试！”郭飞心神一动，兵符竟然出现在了掌心，一团微不可查的白色光芒从兵符中闪出，覆盖在快要闭眼的杨营长身体上，杨营长凭空消失。
“咦！不见了。”旁边观察的老二一怔道。
郭飞微微一怔发现，杨营长竟然进入了自己的兵符空间中，正躺在刚才的棺材中，此时他身体中溢出了团团的灰色气体，如同一个茧一样将其尸体包裹了起来，身体上的伤口开始缓慢的愈合，弹性的皮肤如同缩水一样的收缩，紧紧的贴在了骨骸上。
郭飞手心一握，兵符又化作了印记，沉入了手心中。同时心中大喜，兵符在出现的时候，竟然可以收死尸，连其手中紧握的长剑也收了进去，好似能储存东西。只是不知道能不能储存活物。
并且，郭飞已然明了，尸兵就是这样得到的。兵符空间选择尸兵，必须是在其将死未死，灵魂未消散的时候，而且对身体可能也有要求，在混乱的战场中，在郭飞附近有很多将死未死的尸体，但兵符没有反应，表明这些人不符合要求。
只是，郭飞不知道，他从频死状态进化为尸兵需要多少时间，能力怎么样？尸兵在游戏中并不是厉害的兵种，攻击和防御虽然比剑兵高，但行动呆滞，速度慢，不知道在现实的世界中会如何。

只是，这个尸兵不到万不得已的时候万万不可拿出来用，将人化为尸兵，这么诡异的事情，必定遭到人族的唾弃，说不定成为众矢之的。

Chapter 9 A Corpse Soldier
Guo Fei compared the heat flow of the sword shadow with the air flow from the outside world. The two were originally the same gas, but the heat flow transformed by the sword shadow into the body had more pure energy, which greatly increased Guo Fei's confidence in the military talisman.
"Could this be the Five Elements Qi they talk about!" Guo Fei guessed.
"Boom!" Just when Guo Fei felt that he was unable to do anything, and was about to slow down the attack, his body swayed, and it seemed that a huge air flow from heaven and earth suddenly penetrated into his body, as if the rules were reversed, and it was forcibly injected into his body. The sword shadow's true energy was instantly replenished, and it seemed to be thicker and purer than before.
"Sword Soldier Level 2, increased attack power, upgraded." Guo Fei's spiritual consciousness penetrated into the weapon talisman space and got the information instantly. This made Guo Fei extremely happy. Sure enough, he could upgrade, and upgrading could actually replenish his energy.
The ghost skeleton soldiers were defeated steadily in the battle with the human infantry. Compared with the human race, the ghost tribe's weapons were backward and their troops were smaller than the human race. The battle lasted for three hours, and the human race infantry drove the ghost tribe to the edge of the sea of ​​fog released by the ghost tribe in the Sunset Desert.
"Ouch!" With a harsh ghost cry, the skeleton soldiers hid in the mist like a tide.
"Something's wrong! Brothers, retreat." While the other soldiers cheered and pursued, Jin Datong frowned and reminded quickly.
The formation immediately turned into a "cone", Guo Fei changed from the leader to the last, and the ten people retreated in a hurry.
"Boom, boom, boom!" A thunderous sound came, and groups of bone horse ghost riders rushed out of the mist, charging towards the human infantry.
These ghost knights were covered in shiny black armor, their faces covered by mist, and with a sharp bone gun in their hands, they struck row after row, killing all the human soldiers in one round.
Guo Fei and others' team was at the outermost edge of the battlefield, and their retreat speed was not slow, but the ghost knights charging behind them were faster.
"So many skeleton knights!" Jin Datong yelled in horror, leading nine people to hide behind a big rock on the edge of the battlefield.
The cavalry clearly restrained the infantry. The knight's lance, which was more than ten feet long, instantly picked up the infantry one by one and hit the infantry behind them, causing a rain of blood. Even if he survived the injury, he was trampled into pulp by the thick bone horse hooves that flew by instantly.
"Dang, Dang, Dang!" At this time, the human race's Mingjin troop withdrawal gong sounded.
"Grandma, you're a bear. Whoever becomes the commander is asking the brothers to die!" Jin Datong led ten people and hid in a gap behind a bush of stones on the edge of the battlefield to avoid the attack of the skeleton knight.
Ten people lay down in the snowdrift, covering their bodies with the snow in the gaps between the rocks, covering them up. Guo Fei lay on the outside, observing the entire battlefield from the gap.
Fortunately, they found this hiding place. The retreating infantry couldn't outrun the skeleton cavalry. They fell down in rows. Only then did the human cavalry swarm out of the cavalry channel on the black wall.
"Boss, do you think the human race will be defeated?" Lao Ba was also participating in such a battle for the first time, and he was a little worried.
"I don't know, just wait and see. We are all cannon fodder. It is not us who really determine the outcome. Those masters are ready to go and prepare for the final battle. They are the key to determining the final outcome. We are just consuming strength." Jin Datong closed his eyes to regain his strength and said calmly.
"Cannon fodder!" Lao Jiu was startled, with a hint of sadness in his eyes.
"Brother, if there are too many ants, they can kill an elephant. In such a battle, masters can only appear last. If they also participate in the melee, they may be surrounded and die. Every master is the treasure of the kingdom and will not die here in vain. Most of them are low-level warriors like us who participate in such melee. Only a small number of battalion commanders are Qi monks." The second brother explained with a faint smile.
"Chichichi!" As soon as the second child finished speaking, a figure quickly ran towards the big rock here from the center of the battlefield. Guo Fei looked at it and was stunned.He was stunned for a moment. This man was a battalion commander. When they were forming formation at Heibi, his battalion was on the right side of Guo Fei and others. Guo Fei had seen this man before, and his surname seemed to be Yang.
Battalion Commander Yang was obviously injured. He was shot in the arm and thigh. There were more than a dozen knights chasing after him. One of the knights held a black spear in his hand. The horse he was riding was not a bone horse, but a real horse, but a dead horse. Its skin clings tightly to the bones as if it has shrunk, its eyes are shining with dark red light, and it is flying as fast as lightning through the snow that is deep into its calves.
"No, ghost horse and black knight. This is an intermediate ghost guard! Even more powerful than the one who attacked our military camp last time." The second brother yelled nervously. Even Jin Datong, who was resting with his eyes closed, was stunned. He opened his eyes and hurriedly took a peek.
"Grandma, you are a bear. This is probably a small leader of the ghost cavalry. This time the ghost tribe is going to play big. I have been here for two years and I have never heard or seen such high-level ghost soldiers. Brothers, prepare to run away!" Jin Datong waved his hand and motioned for everyone to dodge behind the big rock. Be prepared to escape from the side under the cover of rocks.
"Chi!" The ghost horse black rider raised his spear, and a gray cyclone flashed out, hitting Camp Commander Yang's back directly. Camp Commander Yang was knocked away by the gray cyclone, his armor cracked, revealing a huge wound, and he plunged into the snow nest, with two mouthfuls of blood spurting out of his mouth. The ghost horse and black knight fled, put a gun in his back, turned around and left.
"It's hopeless. The death energy has entered the body, and there is no way to save him." Jin Datong sighed, showing a hint of helplessness. But he seemed to be used to this kind of thing, so he just sighed calmly.
Battalion Commander Yang raised his head with difficulty, his eyes gradually losing their luster, and a cloud of gray energy filled his body.
"Even such a strong man died in an unknown manner on such a battlefield. Just like an ant's fate, will I do the same!" Battalion Commander Yang used to be a majestic master in his mind. Guo Fei showed a trace of regret in his eyes and sighed secretly in his heart.
However, in the blink of an eye, unyielding faith sprouted in Guo Fei's heart. Even if you are an ant, you must hold on to the hope of turning into a butterfly and fly high, and move forward without losing confidence.
At this time, Guo Fei was only ten meters away from Camp Commander Yang, observing through the gaps in the big rocks. At the moment when his eyes were about to close, Guo Fei noticed that in his soldier's talisman, the light in the Corpse Soldier Hall flashed, as if there was a reaction.
Guo Fei's spiritual consciousness also entered the Corpse Soldier Hall and inspected it. There were two hundred huge black coffins arranged in the space of the Corpse Soldier Hall. Each coffin was made of material, and he didn't know what material it was made of. There is a pale white rectangular light and shadow in the coffin, like a ghost.
At this time, in a coffin in the Corpse Soldier Hall, the pale white light and shadow had a hint of grayness, as if it was about to fly out.
"Can you turn into a corpse soldier? Give it a try!" Guo Fei's mind moved, and the soldier talisman actually appeared in the palm of his hand. An invisible white light flashed out from the soldier talisman, covering the body of Battalion Commander Yang who was about to close his eyes. Battalion Commander Yang disappeared out of thin air.
"Hey! It's gone." The second person observing next to him said in shock.
Guo Fei was slightly startled to find that Battalion Commander Yang had actually entered his own soldier talisman space and was lying in the coffin just now. At this time, clouds of gray gas overflowed from his body, wrapping his body like a cocoon. The wounds on his body began to heal slowly, and the elastic skin shrank like shrinkage, clinging tightly to the bones.
Guo Fei shook his hand, and the military talisman turned into a mark again and sank into his hand. At the same time, he was overjoyed. When the soldier talisman appeared, it could actually collect dead bodies. Even the sword he was holding tightly in his hand could be stored in it, as if it could store things. I just don’t know if it can store live animals.
Moreover, Guo Fei already understood that this was how the corpse soldiers were obtained. When choosing a corpse soldier in the soldier space, you must choose it when it is about to die and its soul has not dissipated, and there may also be requirements for the body.In the chaotic battlefield, there were many dead bodies near Guo Fei, but the soldier symbols did not respond, indicating that these people did not meet the requirements.
However, Guo Fei doesn't know how long it will take for him to evolve from a state of frequent death to a corpse soldier, and what is his ability? Corpse soldiers are not a powerful unit in the game. Although their attack and defense are higher than sword soldiers, their movements are sluggish and their speed is slow. I don’t know how they will behave in the real world.
However, this corpse soldier must not be used until absolutely necessary. It can turn people into corpse soldiers. Such a weird thing will definitely be despised by the human race, and may become the target of public criticism.
